data.title: Train Yard: Cargo and Passenger Routes
data.description: Discover how different trains carry people and supplies across the land.

challenges.title: Golden Harvest Run
challenges.instruction: The yard has loaded 1,080 tons of grain into the cars for the trip from Sunny Valley Farm to Big River Port. The route climbs Golden Hill, a 1.8% grade. Add the fewest engines that pull the train up the hill.

challenges.title: Forest Timber Haul
challenges.instruction: The yard has loaded 1,420 tons of lumber into the cars for the trip from Pine Tree Sawmill to Metro Building Supply. The route climbs Pine Ridge Pass, a 2.0% grade. Add the fewest engines that pull the train up the hill.

challenges.title: Fresh Milk Delivery
challenges.instruction: The yard has loaded 1,940 tons of milk into the cars for the trip from Green Pastures Dairy to City Grocery Warehouse. The route climbs Rolling Meadow Grade, a 2.5% grade. Add the fewest engines that pull the train up the hill.

challenges.title: Holiday Package Dash
challenges.instruction: The yard has loaded 830 tons of packages into the cars for the trip from Central Mail Facility to Northern Town Station. The route climbs Snowy Summit, a 2.5% grade. Add the fewest engines that pull the train up the hill.
